head -3 inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv | cut -c1-500; echo "---rows---"; wc -l inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel); library(readxl); library(dplyr)})
expr_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
de_path   <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
## The first row contains  #group Group row，The second row contains sample names
grp_line <- scan(expr_path, what = "", sep = ",", nlines = 1, quiet = TRUE)
expr_raw <- read.csv(expr_path, skip = 1, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
groups  <- trimws(grp_line[-1])          # 12  sample groups
samples <- colnames(expr_raw)[-1]
print(data.frame(sample = samples, group = groups))
cat("\nExpression matrix dimensions:", dim(expr_raw), "\n")
cat("Gene id Total:", nrow(expr_raw), " Unique id:", length(unique(expr_raw$id)), "\n")
de <- read_excel(de_path, sheet = 1) |> as.data.frame()
cat("Differential result dimensions:", dim(de), " Unique id:", length(unique(de$id)), "\n")
cat("log2FC Range:", range(de$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("pvalue NA Count:", sum(is.na(de$pvalue)), "\n")

## Check row order alignment？
n <- min(nrow(expr_raw), nrow(de))
cat("First ", n, " rows id Position agreement:", mean(expr_raw$id[1:n] == de$id[1:n], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("First mismatched position:", which(expr_raw$id[1:n] != de$id[1:n])[1:5], "\n")
print(head(data.frame(expr_id = expr_raw$id[1:6], de_id = de$id[1:6])))
## Direction classification：log2FC  and  (group2Mean - group1Mean)  relationship
m1 <- rowMeans(expr_raw[1:n, samples[groups == "group1"]])
m2 <- rowMeans(expr_raw[1:n, samples[groups == "group2"]])
d  <- m2 - m1
ok <- is.finite(de$log2FoldChange[1:n]) & is.finite(d)
cat("\ncor(log2FC, mean2-mean1) =", cor(de$log2FoldChange[1:n][ok], d[ok]), "\n")
cat("Sign agreement =", mean(sign(de$log2FoldChange[1:n][ok]) == sign(d[ok])), "\n")
print(summary(lm(de$log2FoldChange[1:n][ok] ~ d[ok]))$coefficients)
print(head(data.frame(id = de$id[1:8], log2FC = round(de$log2FoldChange[1:8], 3),
                      mean_g1 = round(m1[1:8], 3), mean_g2 = round(m2[1:8], 3),
                      delta = round(d[1:8], 3))))

## Expression matrix：Average duplicate gene rows；Differential results：For duplicate genes retain the  p minimum entry
expr_agg <- expr_raw |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(samples), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
de_uniq <- de |>
  filter(!is.na(pvalue), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) |>
  arrange(id, pvalue) |>
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
cat("Deduplicated expression matrix:", nrow(expr_agg), " Deduplicated differential results:", nrow(de_uniq), "\n")
cat("Shared genes:", length(intersect(expr_agg$id, de_uniq$id)), "\n")
cat("Only in differential results:", length(setdiff(de_uniq$id, expr_agg$id)),
    " Only ��Expression matrix:", length(setdiff(expr_agg$id, de_uniq$id)), "\n")
g1 <- samples[groups == "group1"]; g2 <- samples[groups == "group2"]
dat <- expr_agg |>
  mutate(mean_g1 = rowMeans(across(all_of(g1))),
         mean_g2 = rowMeans(across(all_of(g2)))) |>
  select(id, mean_g1, mean_g2) |>
  inner_join(de_uniq, by = "id") |>
  mutate(delta = mean_g2 - mean_g1)
cat("\nMerged gene count:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("cor(log2FC, mean_g2-mean_g1) =", round(cor(dat$log2FoldChange, dat$delta), 4), "\n")
cat("Sign agreement =", round(mean(sign(dat$log2FoldChange) == sign(dat$delta)), 4), "\n")
print(head(dat[order(-abs(dat$log2FoldChange)), c("id","mean_g1","mean_g2","delta","log2FoldChange","pvalue")], 8))

p_cut <- 0.05; fc_cut <- 1
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(change = case_when(
    pvalue < p_cut & log2FoldChange >  fc_cut ~ "Up in group2 (CohortB)",
    pvalue < p_cut & log2FoldChange < -fc_cut ~ "Up in group1 (CohortA)",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
print(table(dat$change))
## Expression differences for significant genes |delta| Distribution —— Set the diagonal reference offset
sig <- dat$change != "NS"
cat("\nSignificant genes |delta| Quantiles:\n"); print(round(quantile(abs(dat$delta[sig]), c(.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9)), 3))
cat("Non-significant genes |delta| Quantiles:\n"); print(round(quantile(abs(dat$delta[!sig]), c(.5,.75,.9,.95,.99)), 3))
for (o in c(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5)) {
  cat(sprintf("Offset=%.1f  Proportion of significant genes outside the band=%.3f  Proportion of non-significant genes outside the band=%.3f\n",
              o, mean(abs(dat$delta[sig]) > o), mean(abs(dat$delta[!sig]) > o)))
}
cat("\nExpression range:", round(range(c(dat$mean_g1, dat$mean_g2)), 2), "\n")

## ---- Prepare plotting data ----
dat$change <- factor(dat$change,
                     levels = c("Up in group2 (CohortB)", "Up in group1 (CohortA)", "NS"))
# Labeled genes：Sort significant genes by  -log10(p) * |log2FC| Combined ranking，Select top genes in each direction top10
dat$score <- -log10(pmax(dat$pvalue, .Machine$double.xmin)) * abs(dat$log2FoldChange)
lab <- dat |>
  filter(change != "NS") |>
  group_by(change) |>
  slice_max(score, n = 10) |>
  ungroup()
cols <- c("Up in group2 (CohortB)" = "#D62728",
          "Up in group1 (CohortA)" = "#1F77B4",
          "NS"                 = "grey78")
n_up   <- sum(dat$change == "Up in group2 (CohortB)")
n_down <- sum(dat$change == "Up in group1 (CohortA)")
lims   <- range(c(dat$mean_g1, dat$mean_g2)); lims <- c(floor(lims[1]) - .2, ceiling(lims[2]) + .2)
p <- ggplot(dat, aes(mean_g1, mean_g2)) +
  # Diagonal reference：y = x  and  y = x ± 1
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,  colour = "grey35", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  1, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -1, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_point(data = subset(dat, change == "NS"),
             colour = cols[["NS"]], size = .7, alpha = .45, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = subset(dat, change != "NS"),
             aes(colour = change), size = 1.1, alpha = .75, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = lab, shape = 21, size = 1.9, fill = NA, colour = "black", stroke = .45) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = id, colour = change),
                  size = 2.9, fontface = "italic", show.legend = FALSE,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = .3, segment.colour = "grey50",
                  box.padding = .35, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  annotate("text", x = lims[1] + .3, y = lims[2] - .3, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("Up in CohortB: %d", n_up), colour = cols[["Up in group2 (CohortB)"]], size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = lims[2] - .3, y = lims[1] + .3, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
           label = sprintf("Up in CohortA: %d", n_down), colour = cols[["Up in group1 (CohortA)"]], size = 3.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, breaks = c("Up in group2 (CohortB)", "Up in group1 (CohortA)"),
                      name = NULL) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "group1 (CohortA)  mean log2 expression",
       y = "group2 (CohortB)  mean log2 expression",
       title = "Diagonal volcano plot: group1 (CohortA) vs group2 (CohortB)",
       subtitle = sprintf("colour by DE test (p < %.2g & |log2FC| > %g);  dashed lines: y = x ± 1;  n = %d genes",
                          p_cut, fc_cut, nrow(dat))) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.6, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey92"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey30"),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(.985, .02),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", .8), colour = "grey80", linewidth = .3),
        legend.key.height = unit(11, "pt"), legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5))
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 6.6, height = 6.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf", p, width = 6.6, height = 6.6, bg = "white")
write.csv(dat[order(dat$pvalue), c("id","mean_g1","mean_g2","delta","log2FoldChange","pvalue","change")],
          "diagonal_volcano_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Labeled genes:\n"); print(as.data.frame(lab[, c("id","change","mean_g1","mean_g2","log2FoldChange","pvalue")]))

n_up   <- sum(dat$change == "Up in group2 (CohortB)")
n_down <- sum(dat$change == "Up in group1 (CohortA)")
# Include gene counts in legend labels，Avoid overlap with corner annotations
lv  <- c("Up in group2 (CohortB)", "Up in group1 (CohortA)", "NS")
labs_leg <- c(sprintf("Up in group2 (CohortB), n = %d", n_up),
              sprintf("Up in group1 (CohortA), n = %d", n_down), "NS")

p <- ggplot(dat, aes(mean_g1, mean_g2)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  0, colour = "grey35", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept =  1, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -1, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_point(data = subset(dat, change == "NS"), aes(colour = change),
             size = .7, alpha = .45, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = subset(dat, change != "NS"), aes(colour = change),
             size = 1.1, alpha = .75, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = lab, shape = 21, size = 1.9, fill = NA, colour = "black", stroke = .45) +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = id, colour = change),
                  size = 2.9, fontface = "italic", show.legend = FALSE,

                  box.padding = .45, point.padding = .2, force = 3,

  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, labels = setNames(labs_leg, lv),
                      breaks = lv[1:2], name = NULL) +

       title = "Diagonal volcano plot: group1 (CohortA) vs group2 (CohortB)",
       subtitle = sprintf("colour from DE table (p < %.2g & |log2FC| > %g);  solid line y = x, dashed y = x ± 1;  n = %d genes",
                          p_cut, fc_cut, nrow(dat))) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.6, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey92"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.3, colour = "grey30"),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(.985, .015),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", .85), colour = "grey80", linewidth = .3),
        legend.margin = margin(3, 6, 3, 4),
        legend.key.height = unit(12, "pt"), legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5))
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p, width = 6.6, height = 6.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf", p, width = 6.6, height = 6.6, bg = "white")
write.csv(dat[order(dat$pvalue), c("id","mean_g1","mean_g2","delta","log2FoldChange","pvalue","change")],
